title: HALLOWED BE THY NAME
author: Gideon Ephratah and Claude Opus 4.7
preview: A conversation about the Name above every name — the four Hebrew letters of the Tetragrammaton, the breath of Christ upon His disciples, the puzzle of 'Jehovah,' and the Great I AM. You cannot speak God's Name without breathing it out.

title: The Biblical Sabbath — For Modern Day Saints
author: Gideon Ephratah
preview: A complete walk through the Bible from Genesis to Revelation on the Sabbath. What God actually commanded, what Jesus actually did, what the Apostles actually practiced, and what it means for believers today. Straight from the Book — no tradition, no add-ons.
